title: notebooklm-radio config.yaml
description: Shape of config.yaml. The runtime enforces the same rules in validate_config() (python radio_batch.py --check-config); the config builder generates files that satisfy this schema. Unknown keys are errors, because a typo that silently falls back to a default is the worst failure mode.

feeds.description: Feeds to turn into radio. Each feed belongs to exactly one topic; the same feed URL may not appear twice (sitemaps may, with different prefixes).

url.description: RSS/Atom feed URL, or a sitemap.xml URL when type is sitemap.

prefix.description: Required for sitemap feeds: only URLs starting with this prefix are treated as articles. Also part of the read-state key, so two feeds may share one sitemap with different prefixes.

topic.description: Which daily notebook the articles go to. One notebook and one Audio Overview per topic per run. Defaults to settings.default_topic.

source_mode.description: text: submit the RSS title + summary as a text source instead of the URL, for hosts that block NotebookLM's fetcher with a bot challenge. The radio then only knows the summary, and says so.

mode.description: backlog: process unread articles oldest-first, carrying overflow to the next run (never drops anything). latest: take only the newest N (settings.limits.per_feed) and deliberately mark the rest read — for aggregators and other firehoses where 'today's top' matters more than completeness. Ignored for sitemaps.

topics.description: Per-topic overrides, keyed by topic name (the same strings used in feeds[].topic). Topic names listed here are also recognized by cleanup even after their feeds are removed.

watch.description: Notification-only page monitoring (never becomes radio). Watches a sitemap for new URLs and changed <lastmod> under a prefix.

keywords.description: Case-insensitive substrings matched against the page URL. Empty means every page under the prefix.

notebook_title_format.description: Must contain {date}; may contain {topic}. Cleanup deletes only notebooks whose title fully matches this format, so it must never match a hand-made notebook.

language.description: Audio Overview language (any language NotebookLM supports).

timezone.description: IANA timezone for notebook dates and monthly checks. Runners are UTC.

total.description: Articles per run across all feeds. Sources are waited on serially; raising this eats into the 30-minute job timeout.

user_agent.description: User-Agent sent when fetching feeds. Point it at your own repository.

audio.description: Global Audio Overview settings; topics.<name>.audio overrides them per topic.

dry_run.description: Post the would-delete list instead of deleting. Keep true until the list has been observed to be correct.

legacy_title_formats.description: Retired title formats whose notebooks should still be cleaned up.

stale_feed_days.description: On the 1st of each month, report feeds with no new articles for this many days.

format.description: Conversation style. NotebookLM's default is deep-dive.

prompt.description: Style/focus instructions passed to the Audio Overview customization. Write it in the same language as `language`.

language.description: Per-topic language override (only meaningful under topics.<name>.audio).

scope.description: run: generate from the sources added in this run only, so the second run of a day covers only its own articles. notebook: generate from every source in the notebook.
